name: Forpost-RU

image.license: See Commons file page for license

characteristics: Strength: Largest and most expensive UAV in this catalog batch; long endurance and high-altitude operation
Limitation: Very high unit cost makes it the least numerous, most operationally cautious-to-risk type in the fleet
Estimated quantity available: Small fleet; exact total not disclosed
employment_notes: A license-built derivative of an Israeli design (IAI Searcher), illustrating that Russia's higher-end UAV fleet has historically depended partly on pre-war foreign technology transfer rather than fully domestic design
contrast_vs_traditional: A license-built derivative of an Israeli design, Forpost-RU is another case of existing airframe knowledge repurposed rather than a clean-sheet program — traditional procurement doctrine planning for a decade-long development cycle has given way, across this war, to adapting whatever design and supply chain is actually available on a wartime timeline.

notes: Specs meet the bar but the unit cost is an estimate — cost is not verified.
